A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same IMDPrompter study, with accessible main text and appendices. Equations, tables and figures can be matched across layout changes and appendix renumbering. The clipped Figure 3 in v1 does not prevent method comparison because its operations are also described in text.

before.justification: v1 reports original image manipulation detection and localization results, component ablations, robustness experiments and appendix evaluations, including CocoGlide in Table 18.

after.justification: v2 retains the work's original benchmark results, ablations, robustness experiments and appendix evaluations. These remain original empirical results despite being unchanged from v1.

M1.justification: The four input views, OPS, CPC, CFP and PMM components, training losses and ensemble-based inference remain unchanged. Rewritten explanations and the SAF-to-CFP label correction in Figure 2 do not change the procedure.

E1.justification: Both train on CASIAv2 and evaluate on CASIAv1, COVER, Columbia, IMD2020 and NIST16. Both already include CocoGlide evaluation in Table 18 and the same JPEG compression and Gaussian blur scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in corresponding experiments, including Tables 1-2, FCN and FCN+ in Table 6, MedSAM, MedSAM-Adapter, AutoSAM and SAMed in Table 16, and the CocoGlide baselines in Table 18.

E3.justification: Dataset counts, training settings, preprocessing, evaluation metrics, best-threshold and fixed-0.5 evaluations, and corruption settings are retained. Relocated experimental passages do not introduce revised protocols.

E4.justification: Both retain the component, view-combination, SAM and segmenter ablations; computational analyses; optimal-view selection frequencies; hyperparameter sensitivity; robustness tests; and qualitative examples. Figure 7 moves from page 21 to page 19 without changing its analysis.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged. Both present the same point estimates without reported repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or formal significance tests.

E6.justification: Numerical results, rankings and qualitative findings are retained throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Table 1 retains mean pixel F1 scores of 81.36% and 59.78% under best and fixed thresholds, and Table 18 retains CocoGlide best-threshold pixel F1 of 0.746.

T1.justification: Equations 1-19 retain the same mathematical content. Added punctuation does not revise definitions or reasoning, and neither version contains additional theoretical propositions or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution statements and conclusion retain the same claims: automated SAM adaptation for manipulation detection, the proposed cross-view components, and effectiveness across in-domain, out-of-domain and robustness evaluations.

C2.justification: Interpretations of the ablations, noise-view benefits and robustness results remain unchanged. Both retain the limitations concerning fully generated images and required pixel-level supervision. The broader-impacts rewrite preserves the same substantive argument.

D1.justification: Implementation descriptions and Table 9 retain the same hardware, optimizer, scheduling, preprocessing and training information. The restored diagram displays interpolation and convolution operations already documented in v1; no new implementation or access information is supplied.

R1.justification: The bibliography and principal SAM positioning are unchanged. However, v2 replaces named citations in the foundation-model discussion with unresolved '?' markers and adds unresolved citations in the introduction and broader impacts. Their unidentified sources prevent a reliable judgment about changes in literature coverage.

P1.justification: v2 locally rewrites the introduction, method explanations and broader-impacts paragraph, adds an acknowledgements section, and renumbers the appendix from Section 6 to Section 7. The overall narrative remains intact, while unresolved citation markers introduce new textual defects.

P2.justification: v2 resizes early diagrams, changes Figure 2's SAF block label to CFP, and fits the previously clipped Figure 3 and its caption onto page 5. Figure 7 is relocated, with accompanying page reflow. Table structures and experimental graphics otherwise retain their content.

improvement.justification: v2 improves method presentation by restoring the clipped Figure 3 and correcting Figure 2's module label. However, it introduces unresolved citations in the introduction, related work and broader impacts, including replacements for valid citations. With scientific evidence unchanged, these competing gains in clarity and losses in attribution leave the net quality direction unclear.
